messages.SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
messages.VERIFY_LINK_RESENT: If this address is waiting for confirmation, a new link has just been sent to you.
messages.VAULT_SEALED: Your password changed: enter your recovery code to reopen your vault.
messages.KEYRING_MISSING: Sign in once on the web app to create your vault.
messages.FIRST_SEAL: First time with {person}. Go on only if they read you this fingerprint: {fingerprint}.
messages.FIRST_SEAL_MOVED: This address no longer leads to the same account. Go on only if the person reads you this fingerprint: {fingerprint}.
messages.KEY_CHANGED: The key of {person} changed. Go on only if they read you this fingerprint: {fingerprint}.
messages.TEAM_KEY_UNKNOWN: This device does not know this key of team {team}. Go on only if a lead reads you this fingerprint: {fingerprint}.
messages.NEW_SEALERS: The key of vault {vault} comes from {person}, a first for this vault. Go on only if they read you this fingerprint: {fingerprint}.
messages.SEALER_REFUSED: Vault {vault} stays closed: its key could not be checked. An admin of the vault has to renew it.
messages.LAST_RESORT_WAIT: Vault {vault} is closed: an admin of the vault has to renew its key.
messages.NOBODY_CAN_ACT: Nobody can open vault {vault} any more. Its owner can delete it.
messages.FINGERPRINT_REQUIRED: Unknown key: --yes is not enough. Pass --fingerprint, or run the command in a terminal.
messages.KEY_UNSAFE: Your vault cannot be opened safely. Share nothing and contact support.
messages.KEY_LOG_FOREIGN: Another key was registered for your account. If it was not you, contact support.
messages.TEAM_KEY_LOG_FOREIGN: The key of team {team} changed. If no lead replaced it, contact support.
messages.WRITE_BLOCKED_DEBT: Cannot save: the key of this vault has to be renewed first. The vault's admins were emailed.
messages.WRITE_BLOCKED_TEAM_DEBT: Cannot save: the key of team {team} has to be replaced first. Its leads were emailed.
messages.WRITE_BLOCKED_KUBBLER_DEBT: Cannot save for now: Kubbler is replacing its access key to this vault. Kubbler has been alerted, try again later.
messages.WRITE_BLOCKED_DEBT_ADMIN: Renew the key of this vault to save in it.
messages.ROTATION_UNFINISHED: Renewal interrupted. Finish it to save again.
messages.NO_PAYER: Nobody can renew the key of this vault. Remove team {team}, or delete the vault.
messages.TEAM_KEY_ROTATING: The key of team {team} is being replaced. Try again in a moment.
messages.SECRET_SET_ASIDE: {secret} cannot be read. Enter its value again, or delete it.
messages.ROTATION_UNPROVEN: Cannot renew from this device, nothing was changed. Another admin of the vault can try.
messages.TEAM_DEBT_SHARE: The key of team {team} has to be replaced: a former member still holds it. Share anyway?
messages.SHARE_PENDING: This vault is waiting for your answer.
messages.SHARE_INVALID: This share cannot be checked. Decline it and ask for a new share.
messages.SHARE_CHANGED: This share changed. Open it again.
messages.SHARE_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot share with this address. Check it, or ask the person to sign in to sharedenv once.
messages.TEAM_KEY_NOT_PROVISIONED: You do not have the key of team {team} yet. Ask a lead for it.
messages.TEAM_KEY_NOT_INITIALISED: Team {team} has no key yet. A lead has to create it.
messages.SHARING_POLICY: Your organization does not allow this share.
messages.STRANGER_TEAM_READ_ONLY: This team can only receive this vault read-only.
messages.ACCESS_DENIED: Your access does not allow this. Ask an admin of the vault.
messages.OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner of the vault can do this.
messages.TEAM_LEAD_REQUIRED: Only the team's leads can do this.
messages.LEAD_SELF_PROVISION: Another lead has to give you the team key.
messages.SELF_ADD_REFUSED: Another admin has to add you to this vault.
messages.OPEN_IN_WEB_APP: You can: open the vault in the web app.
messages.WRITE_BLOCKED_DEBT_NOTICE: An admin of the vault has to renew its key. Until then, nothing can be saved in it.
messages.NEW_SEALERS_REMOVED: The key of vault {vault} comes from {person}. You had removed this person from this vault on this device. They have just put their seal on it. Go on only if they read you this fingerprint: {fingerprint}.
